# Lindsey Dortch

> Ciao, I'm Lindsey Dortch, a Dallas native who started in marketing and now solves the problems I used to wait on engineers to fix. Today I'm a Senior Software Engineer working at the intersection of growth, user experience, and product.

I'm currently looking for Full Stack Senior Software Engineer roles, especially work at the intersection of growth, user experience, and product.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TanStack Start, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, vanilla JavaScript, Angular
- Backend, databases and cloud: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Prisma, Express.js, NestJS, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Salesforce Commerce Cloud
- AI: prompt engineering, agentic AI, MCP, RAG, Claude Code, Codex
